direct.quote: On MedAnswerSet, the vanilla LLM has 29.9% hallucination frequency.
We measure 21.4% hallucination frequency for the retrieve-then-read model on MedAnswerSet.
On MedAnswerSet, the RAG without reranking has 47.2% hallucination frequency.
On HistoryQuest, the closed-book model has 33.5% unsupported-answer rate.
On HistoryQuest, the RAG pipeline has 40.2% unsupported-answer rate.
The RAG with random passages shows 36.4% unsupported-answer rate on HistoryQuest.
On HistoryQuest, the chain-of-thought prompting has 13.1% unsupported-answer rate.
On BioClaimQA, the parametric-only model has 30.1% hallucination rate.
We measure 22.4% hallucination rate for the retrieval-augmented generator on BioClaimQA.
The chain-of-thought prompting shows 39.4% hallucination rate on BioClaimQA.
The query-rewriting variant shows 38.3% hallucination rate on BioClaimQA.

direct.condition: plain generator with no lookup step
direct.metric: fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts
direct.quote: In terms of the fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts, the plain generator with no lookup step corresponds to 299 out of 1,000 MedAnswerSet questions.

direct.condition: configuration that looks up supporting documents
direct.metric: fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts
direct.quote: For the configuration that looks up supporting documents, we observe 21.4% as the fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts on MedAnswerSet.

direct.metric: fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts
direct.quote: For the retrieval variant that skips the reranker, we observe 0.472 as the fraction of answers judged to contain invented facts on MedAnswerSet.

direct.condition: model that answers from its own parameters
direct.metric: proportion of answers with a statement not backed by any source
direct.quote: With the model that answers from its own parameters, the proportion of answers with a statement not backed by any source on HistoryQuest came to 0.335.

direct.quote: On HistoryQuest, the proportion of answers with a statement not backed by any source of the model prompted to reason step by step was 0.131.

direct.quote: On BioClaimQA, the share of answers that contain at least one unsupported statement of the variant that reads retrieved evidence first was 22.4%.

direct.quote: On BioClaimQA, the variant that reformulates the question before the search reaches 383 out of 1,000 questions in terms of the share of answers that contain at least one unsupported statement.

relative.quote: On MedAnswerSet, the retrieve-then-read model scores 8.5 percentage points lower than the vanilla LLM in hallucination frequency.
On HistoryQuest, the RAG pipeline scores 6.7 percentage points higher than the closed-book model in unsupported-answer rate.
On BioClaimQA, the retrieval-augmented generator scores 7.7 percentage points lower than the parametric-only model in hallucination rate.
